title: 重症醫學
intro: 呼吸器、血流動力學、腎臟替代與多重器官衰竭照護。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Ventilation, haemodynamics, renal replacement and multi-organ failure care. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 呼吸器設定基礎
procedures.patient: 依課程「呼吸器設定基礎」設定的虛擬情境：模式、潮氣量 6 mL/kg、PEEP、平台壓與驅動壓。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Mechanical ventilation basics": Modes, 6 mL/kg tidal volume, PEEP, plateau and driving pressure. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
